  "winner": "A",
  "reasons": [
    "Idea A defines a concrete product: consolidated, community-maintained Free Pascal/Lazarus docs with a git-PR contribution workflow. Idea B's own source marks its concept as unconfirmed ('one-line description to confirm') and its customer as 'varies by idea'.",
    "A's demand evidence is three sourced quotes across 2010, 2014 and 2024 (mailing lists and Reddit), showing the same documentation pain persisting over time. B's demand evidence is one Reddit post seen through a mirror, and the same thread contains a direct rebuttal of the premise ('you can just vibe code if you have an idea').",
    "A's price hypothesis (~$50/mo business tier) is anchored to sourced comparables, Read the Docs Business at $50/mo and GitBook at $65–$249/mo, and names a specific target payer: companies shipping commercial Lazarus-based products.",
    "B's brief describes its niche as saturated with near-identical, no-traction, single-founder projects, some showing dummy or fake data. Its only priced comparable, CoFoundersLab at $29/mo, sits in an adjacent category and carries a class-action billing complaint.",
    "A's source material is free to repurpose and its audience is already gathered in a known forum, giving a solo AI-agent builder a zero-cash outreach channel. B's acquisition-cost estimate comes from a vendor blog the brief itself flags as not independently verified."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "B's demand evidence is a single Reddit quote reached through a third-party mirror snapshot, not the original post. The same thread contains a community rebuttal arguing that AI vibe coding removes the need, so the one demand signal partly undercuts itself.",
  "confidence_note": "Low confidence. Neither brief shows any paying customer. A's own case against notes that no one has paid for Pascal docs, that the Foundation funds development rather than docs, that a 2012 thread suggests the real blocker may be maintainer engagement rather than tooling, and that the audience looks small. A wins mainly because B is undefined and has weaker, self-contradicting demand evidence, not because A's path to revenue within 90 days is shown."
}
